reason: The whiteboard and the notebook have run my bracket for years and nobody has ever complained. Half of what I'd be paying for is a live bracket on the wall, and I don't have a wall - I don't have a venue at all, I borrow whatever space will have us.
objection: The people who help me on the night are not going to learn new software - it will end up being me on my phone fixing it while twenty regulars stand around waiting, and the whiteboard never did that to me.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked for someone like me with no venue - bracket and league table on the players' own phones, no screen needed - and I could run a whole night without touching it after setup, I'd try the free month.
